_what_this_is: The measured act-or-not reading for image-bearing watch cases: the number src/README.md line 25 was missing.
_where_it_comes_from: run 2026-10-25 in session seek-opensource-task on the host's own laptop, against calibration/vision/cases.json
_why_this_file_exists: so the claim that images were measured is inspectable rather than a paragraph asserting it

model.quant: Q4_0 — the quant docs/decisions.md names as the bundled one, so this reading describes the shipped artifact

projector.note: the smallest projector the checkpoint publishes (the other two are F16 and BF16)

model.both_verified: both files were checked against the sha256 the hub publishes for them

runner.what: llama.cpp built from source at 701fd25 (ggml-org/llama.cpp), libmtmd + libllama, one-shot scorer
runner.why_not_the_earlier_harness: provenance.md records llama-cpp-python with a LogitsProcessor; that cannot take an image, so the reading is taken through libmtmd instead
runner.how_the_probability_was_read: the next-token distribution at the end of the formatted prompt, summed over every token whose decoded form strips to 'act' — the same estimator the text run used
runner.prompt_shape: the shipped watch-v1 shape: system, then 'Message: <text>', then the image, then 'Do you need to do something about this message? Answer act or ignore.'

cases.label: act
cases.note: 中文截图，只有图能看出是支付故障

diagnosed.why_some_images_are_missed: raising the image token budget to 1024 does not fix them and costs about 3x the time: a4 rises 0.438 -> 0.739 (now correct) while a1 falls 0.616 -> 0.585 (now wrong), and a5/a6/a8 rise but stay under the cut. The misses are judgement, not resolution.

other_quant.note: the same 16 cases scored 12/16, AUC 0.891 on Q4_K_M before the shipped quant was downloaded; the verdict does not turn on the quant

what_was_not_measured: One message with one image, never a box of several messages or several images.
Screenshots rendered for this set, not captured from a real chat — the same provenance as the text cases.
n=16: eight images per label is a wide interval, and the two Chinese cases are too few to make the language split a reading.
The runtime mask is untouched by this run: the scorer reads the full next-token distribution, the kernel masks one id.
